يجتذبا (form VIII)
# يَجْتَذِبَا (yajtaḏibā) /jad͡ʒ.ta.ði.baː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# يُجْتَذَبَا (yujtaḏabā) /jud͡ʒ.ta.ða.baː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
